name: Moondusk Masquerade
source:
Frequently reminded about how she was rescued by faeries despite being a human, Lilika (renamable MC) has lived all her life repaying the faeries with her servitude — to cook, clean, and care for the heirs of an elite faerie family in the realm. When the family receives their annual invitation to an upcoming masquerade held by the High Court, Lilika is surprised to also receive an invitation letter, only to have her dreams crushed by the family’s objections.

Lilika refuses to let go of her dreams of romance and dancing amongst the sparkling high court faeries. Her wishes are soon heard by a mysterious flower spirit in the garden and the spirit helps Eve get to the ball.

Believing in the flower spirit, Lilika finds herself at the masquerade in a beautiful disguise and is able to put aside her human identity for a magical evening. But her night soon begins to unmask a stunning mystery - one that ties a clandestine prince, a grand magician, and a roguish knight to her destiny through passionate secrets and mysterious letters by moondusk.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
尽管身为人类，莉莉卡（可重命名为MC）却经常被提醒自己是如何被仙灵拯救的，她一生都在用她的奴役来回报仙灵——做饭、打扫卫生，并照顾王国里一个精英仙灵家庭的继承人。当一家人收到高等法院即将举行的化装舞会的年度邀请时，莉莉卡惊讶地发现自己也收到了邀请函，但她的梦想却因家人的反对而破灭。

莉莉卡拒绝放弃她对浪漫和与闪闪发光的宫廷仙女共舞的梦想。她的愿望很快被花园里的神秘花精听到，花精帮助夏娃参加舞会。

莉莉卡相信花的精神，发现自己以美丽的伪装出现在化装舞会上，并能够抛开自己的人类身份，度过一个神奇的夜晚。但她的夜晚很快就开始揭开一个惊人的谜团——一个秘密王子、一个大魔法师和一个流氓骑士通过充满激情的秘密和月黄昏的神秘信件与她的命运联系在一起。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549690/]Steam[/url]]
